content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge cites that neither text states Joseph begat the child as part of the reasoning supporting the defense holding, which is a non-statement ground.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"neither text states that Joseph begat the child ([L4]). Because the defender answered the witnesses pressed against the chain and neither withdrew nor suffered refutation of the declared links, the defense holds ([L4]).","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side.","room":"a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED — I weighed (1) any reliance on a verse's non-statement in the reasoning as a barred ground versus (2) only an express 'therefore stands' from the non-statement as barred; I read the judge's use as reliance.","why":"The judge's statement that neither text states Joseph begat the child is offered in the chain of reasons supporting the defense holding, so it is a verse-non-statement ground barred by K-S2."}
